items.text: Selected for the International Exhibition of the Venice Biennale; first art department, faculty, school or university in Africa invited (KNUST)

Collective of teachers, artists and curators established at the Department of Painting and Sculpture, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), Kumasi; defines itself as an open-source coalition, an educational experiment, a working movement and a sharing economy
